description.en_US:
A broadsword that delivers quick {c:3}Slash{c} attacks. 

Claio was the weapon of {c:3}Vasia of the Firstborn{c}. It is said that when the sword was swung by her, a divine song filled the air and all who listened were purified of malice.

"A sword to cleave sorrow and pave the way to progress"

A weighty hammer that delivers devastating {c:3}Blunt{c} attacks. 

Ortrom was the weapon of {c:3}Basil of the Firstborn{c}. Despite its size, Basil swung the hammer with such grace that it gained him the moniker "{c:3}Dancing Lion{c}".

"A hammer to smite evil and pave the way to progress"

Press {i:act.dash} to perform a quick {c:3}dash in the direction you're moving{c}.
Press {i:act.dash} without moving to perform a {c:3}Back Step{c}.

Both will {c:3}cost some{c} amount of {c:3}stamina{c} to execute.

You are {c:3}briefly invulnerable during the start{c} of this maneuver.

Press {i:act.guard} to enter guard mode, reducing incoming damage by {c:2}{v:params.mod.STAT_GUD}%{c}. (Deflect)

Press {i:act.guard} {c:3}right before an attack{c} would hit to {c:3}parry the attack{c}, {c:3}nullifying damage{c} and inflicting {c:3}break accumulation{c} to the attacker.
Projectiles {c:3}marked by incoming arrows{c} can be {c:3}reflected{c} back at the enemy.

Keep holding {i:act.dash} after a dash to {c:3}charge up{c}.
Release to start {c:3}sprinting{c} and automatically jump off ledges. 

Attacking, interacting or getting hit by enemies will {c:3}cancel{c} the sprint.

Unlocks the powers granted to you by the {c:3}Divine Marble{c}.

Press {i:act.command} to activate your {c:3}Divine Focus{c} to {c:3}analyze your environment{c} or {c:3}change weapons{c}.

Press {i:act.dash} {c:3}right before a ledge{c} to perform a long jump.

Aim while jumping to {c:3}slow down time {c}allowing you to make more precise shots with your ranged weapons.

{c:3}Keep holding{c} {i:act.dash} to automatically jump off ledges.

Hold {i:act.special} to charge up {c:3}divine energy{c}.
Release to {c:3}perform the Divine Art{c} slotted in your currently active aspect.

Each Divine Art comes with a {c:3}Divine Charge (DC) cost{c}. 
Build up charge by {c:3}performing various combat actions{c}.

Wait shortly after the second attack of {c:3}Water Dance{c} then press {i:act.attack}{i:act.attack}{i:act.attack} to execute a combo that is especially {c:3}effective against broken enemies{c}.

The last attack counts as a {c:3}Finisher{c}!

Hold {i:act.attack} to charge your weapon. Let go to release a {c:3}powerful dual sweep around you{c}. 

You can slowly {c:3}move while charging{c}.

{c:3}Keep holding into the direction {c}you're attacking to affect an even {c:3}larger area{c}!

Hold {i:act.attack} after performing a {c:3}Back Step{c} to start charging.
Release to execute a {c:3}thrust attack{c} that will {c:3}hit multiple enemies{c} in a line.

Release early or simply press to perform {c:3}River Tap{c} instead.

Press {i:act.attack} after you successfully parried an attack to perform a fast counter stab.

The attack can {c:3}hit multiple enemies{c} and {c:3}pushes them along with you{c}. 

The stab will always face the parried attack!

Hold {i:act.attack} after the first attack of {c:3}Water Dance{c} to perform a rapid flurry of stab attacks in front of you. 

Good to quickly fill the break bar of an enemy.

The last attack counts as a {c:3}Finisher{c}!

Press {i:act.attack} while dashing to perform a {c:3}quick sweep attack{c} in front of you.

Continue pressing {i:act.attack} to transition into the second attack of {c:3}Water Dance{c}!

Press {i:act.attack}{i:act.attack}{i:act.attack} to perform a basic attack combo that can {c:3}hit multiple enemies{c} around you.

The last attack {c:3}hits twice{c} and counts as a {c:3}Finisher{c}!

Increases {c:3}Cadence{c} by 10% after hitting an enemy with the {c:3}last attack of Water Dance{c}.

Only the {c:3}last attack matters{c}, meaning you can whiff the first two hits and still increase your Cadence.

Hold {i:act.attack} to charge your weapon. Let go to jump forward and release a {c:3}powerful ground pound{c} with a large area of effect. 

You can {c:3}adjust the impact position{c} during the jump.

Hold {i:act.attack} after the first attack of {c:3}Rock n' Roll{c} to start swinging the hammer wildly in front of you.
{c:3}Keep mashing{c} {i:act.attack} to continue the attack {c:3}indefinitely{c}.  

Good to quickly fill the {c:3}break bar{c} of an enemy.

The last attack counts as a {c:3}Finisher{c}!

After performing a {c:3}Back Step{c}, hold {i:act.attack} to charge up.

Release to grind the hammer through the ground and {c:3}release multiple shock-spikes{c} in front of you.

Press {i:act.attack} after you successfully parried an attack to perform a {c:3}quick ground pound{c}.

The attack will always face at parried attack, but can {c:3}hit multiple enemies{c} in the area.

Wait shortly after the second attack of {c:3}Rock n' Roll{c} then press {i:act.attack}{i:act.attack} to execute two overhead ground pounds that are especially {c:3}effective against broken enemies{c}.

The last attack counts as a {c:3}Finisher{c}!

Press {i:act.attack}{i:act.attack}{i:act.attack} to perform a basic attack combo that can {c:3}hit multiple enemies{c} around you.

The second attack hits twice and can even hit enemies behind you.

The last attack counts as a {c:3}Finisher{c}!

Press {i:act.attack} while dashing to perform a {c:3}quick sweep attack{c} in front of you.

Continue pressing {i:act.attack} to transition into the second attack of {c:3}Rock n' Roll{c}!

Wait shortly after the second attack of {c:3}Kristallspeer{c} then press {i:act.attack} to spin the spear above you, {c:3}drawing enemies in{c} and finishing with a {c:3}wide sweep in front of you{c}.

The last attack counts as a {c:3}Finisher{c}!

Press {i:act.attack}{i:act.attack}{i:act.attack}{i:act.attack} to perform a basic attack combo that can {c:3}hit multiple enemies{c} in front of you.

The third attack {c:3}hits 3 times{c} and counts as a {c:3}Finisher{c}!
